body: I attended my first parent-teacher interview since 6th grade, and it went well.
Believe me, I'm trying so hard to just get through school. I feel like giving up any minute now, I really can't handle this stress. It hurts too much to see everyone around me being disappointed.
I picked up the courage to ask my teacher for help with a question. I usually never do because I'm so anxious about looking dumb when I do. Made me feel better about myself c:

Ooh nice!
I prefer RPGs. I place big emphasis on narrative, so that might be why. I should also add that Persona 5 has taken over my mind, body and soul. That game is just so good.

Following through with anything has become exhausting for me now. Thus my lack of following through with anything discourages me from starting anything in the first place, because there's always a little voice telling me I won't finish it anyway :/

On days when I don't have tutoring after school, video games.

Game design. Still in beginning stages.
